# tools: investigate ShellHistory

Look at [ShellHistory](https://loshadki.app/shellhistory/), a macOS app that records shell history with context (directory, session, duration, exit code) and syncs via iCloud; the author's [dbhist](https://www.outcoldman.com/en/archive/2017/07/19/dbhist/) post describes the earlier SQLite-history idea behind it. **Motivation:** "improve terminal DX" — the same need as atuin ([[DOT-482]]), with a native GUI instead of a TUI.
